title: Compositional Invariants and Bias Boundaries in Sparse Count Systems
scientific_scope: All frozen anonymous feature-count rows, sample covariates, and bias-scenario metrics within the selected composition-analysis boundary.
analysis_unit: One complete sample composition or one complete simulated bias scenario; features within a composition share a closure constraint.
